steps.name: jkp_ctry2
steps.sql: select excntry, eom, count(*) as n, sum(me) as me_tot, sum(case when be_me is not null then me*be_me end)/nullif(sum(case when be_me is not null then me end),0) as bm_agg, sum(case when ni_me is not null then me*ni_me end)/nullif(sum(case when ni_me is not null then me end),0) as ep_agg, sum(case when div12m_me is not null then me*div12m_me end)/nullif(sum(case when div12m_me is not null then me end),0) as dp_agg, sum(case when ret_exc_lead1m is not null then me*ret_exc_lead1m end)/nullif(sum(case when ret_exc_lead1m is not null then me end),0) as ret_lead_vw from contrib_global_factor.global_factor where common=1 and primary_sec=1 and obs_main=1 and exch_main=1 and me>0 and size_grp in ('mega','large','small') and (ret_exc_lead1m is null or ret_exc_lead1m between -0.95 and 3) and excntry in ('USA','GBR','DEU','FRA','JPN','CAN','AUS','HKG','CHE','SWE','NLD','ITA','ESP','DNK','NOR','BEL','AUT','PRT','CHN','KOR','TWN','IND','BRA','MEX','ZAF') and eom>='1980-01-01' group by excntry, eom
